# Comparison fixtures

## Provenance

Comparison fixtures cover both deterministic synthetic workbooks and approved local export-shape references.

| File | Provenance class | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scopus_export_sample.xlsx` | Synthetic, generated | Deterministic workbook generated by `generate_scopus_fixture.py` for reader/comparison smoke tests. |
| `artifact_shapes.json` | Export-derived, local-artifact snapshot | Copied on 2026-03-27 from `docs/syntheca_post_impl_audit/research/live_samples/scopus_export_artifact_shapes.json`. Contains header/preview snapshots for approved local Scopus/SciVal workbooks already present in this repository. It is a contract-shape fixture, not a golden result baseline. |

## Usage rules

- Keep the workflow export-first; these fixtures are for file-shape validation, not direct Scopus API behavior.
- `artifact_shapes.json` is intentionally descriptive rather than executable workbook data, so tests can stay lightweight and offline.
- Source-list workbooks that do not match document-export shapes remain out of scope unless explicitly documented otherwise.
